cookies.title: Cookie policy
cookies.description: This website only stores the technical items in the table in your browser: the language you choose, the theme you view the site in and, only if a site update interrupts your browsing, what is needed to reload the page. It uses no tracking, advertising or analytics cookies.

colorMode.purpose: Stores the theme: your device’s setting until you choose light or dark

i18n.purpose: Stores the language you choose with the language selector, so the home page opens in that language

reload.purpose: Recovers the page if a site update interrupts your browsing. While it reloads, nuxt:reload:state keeps the page’s state, including anything you typed in the form

cookies.note: The cookie is only created when you change language with the language selector (the flag in the navigation bar) and is updated whenever you change it again. Visiting the site does not create it, not even when the home page opens in your browser’s language. The theme is stored from your first visit: it follows your device’s setting until you choose light or dark with the theme button. Session storage is only used if a site update forces the page to reload while you browse, and your browser deletes it when you close the tab. These items are only used to show you the site in that language and theme and to recover the page after an update, for nothing else, and are not shared with third parties. They are therefore considered strictly necessary to provide the service you request and are exempt from consent under Article 22.2 of the Spanish LSSI, which transposes Article 5(3) of Directive 2002/58/EC.

contactForm.title: Contact form
contactForm.description: When you use the contact form, the following personal data are collected:

dataCollected.title: Data collected
items: Name: to identify you and personalise the response
Email address: to reply to your enquiry
Subject and message: to handle your request
The site language you write from: to reply in that language

purpose.title: Purpose of processing
purpose.description: The data you send will be used solely to respond to your enquiry or proposal and to protect the form against abuse, such as automated submissions or spam. They will not be used for any other purpose.

legitimation.title: Legal basis
legitimation.description: Replying to your enquiry is based on your consent, given when submitting the contact form (Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR); protecting the form against abuse is based on the legitimate interest in protecting the site (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR).

retention.title: Data retention
retention.description: Form data are sent directly by email and are not stored in the website’s databases. Emails will be kept only as long as necessary to address the enquiry.

recipients.title: Recipients
recipients.description: Data will not be shared with third parties, unless required by law.

privacy.title: General privacy
items: Visits are measured with Umami, a privacy-friendly analytics tool hosted on my own server, without third-party services
Umami uses no cookies and does not store your IP address; it only provides aggregate statistics and does not identify individual visitors

To prevent abuse, the server counts contact form submissions and the security (CSP) reports your browser sends automatically. It links them to a code derived from your IP address with a secret key, never to the address itself
That code is deleted within 70 minutes at most. The legal basis is the legitimate interest in protecting the site (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR)
No data are shared with third parties

rights.title: Your rights (GDPR)
rights.description: Under the General Data Protection Regulation, you have the right to:
items: Access: request information about your personal data
Rectification: correct inaccurate or incomplete data
Erasure: request the deletion of your data
Objection: object to the processing of your data
Portability: receive your data in a structured format
Restriction: request a limitation of processing
Withdrawal of consent: withdraw it at any time, without affecting the lawfulness of earlier processing
rights.contact: To exercise these rights, write to me through the {form}, stating which right you wish to exercise. You also have the right to lodge a complaint with the Spanish Data Protection Agency (AEPD).
rights.cookiesNote: You can delete this site’s cookie, local storage and session storage at any time in your browser settings.
